commitments.target: First stage of investments in the Odisha site will probably be in the range of INR1,500 crore to INR2,000 crore.
commitments.quote: So I believe that when we actually get down to it, the first stage of investments in the Odisha site will probably be in the range of INR1,500 crore to INR2,000 crore.
commitments.speaker: Ashish Bharat Ram

commitments.target: Adding a second pharma intermediate plant at an investment of INR180 crore in the next 8 months.
commitments.quote: In light of this, we are adding a second pharma intermediate plant at an investment of INR180 crore to come up at our Dahej site, which is expected to be commissioned in the next 8 months.
commitments.speaker: Ashish Bharat Ram

claims.claim: Gross operating revenue grew 6 percent to INR3,713 crore and EBIT was up by 23 percent year-on-year to INR653 crore.
claims.quote: Our gross operating revenue grew 6% to INR3,713 crore and EBIT was up by 23% year-on-year from INR529 crore to INR653 crore over the current period last year, reflecting a margin of 18%.

claims.claim: PAT expanded by 60 percent year-on-year to INR433 crore.
claims.quote: PAT expanded by 60% year-on-year to INR433 crore.

claims.claim: Chemicals Business reported a revenue growth of 22 percent, increasing from INR1,496 crore to INR1,825 crore.
claims.quote: Our Chemicals Business reported a revenue growth of 22%, increasing from INR1,496 crore in quarter 3 financial year '25 to INR1,825 crore in quarter 3 financial year '26.

claims.claim: Advancements have not reflected in financial performance due to persistent customer pricing pressure from Chinese competitors.
claims.quote: However, these advancements have not fully reflected in this quarter's financial performance due to persistent pricing pressure from customers, driven largely by irrational pricing from Chinese competitors across some of our core product categories.

claims.claim: Performance Films & Foils revenue declined 3 percent year-on-year to INR1,342 crore while delivering higher EBIT of INR95 crore.
claims.quote: The Performance Films & Foils business reported revenue of INR1,342 crore in quarter 3 financial year '26, a decline of 3% year-on-year but delivering higher EBIT of INR95 crore when compared to quarter 3 financial year '25 of INR90 crore

claims.claim: Technical Textiles business reported revenue of INR454 crore amid a challenging market environment.
claims.quote: Our Technical Textiles business reported revenue of INR454 crore in quarter 3 financial year '26, amid a challenging market environment.

analyst_concerns.question: How do we envisage our capex outlook going forward in light of global dislocation and trade tariffs?
analyst_concerns.quote: In light of what's happening globally in terms of dislocation or trade tariffs etc., how do we envisage our capex outlook going forward? In the second quarter, we had given guidance of maybe INR2,200 crore, INR2,300 crore of capex. And if you could give us some sense of how do we see this pan out for FY27 too?

analyst_concerns.question: Dichotomy between continued Chinese pricing pressure and expectations of a substantially better fourth quarter.
analyst_concerns.quote: At the same time, we have talked of fourth quarter being substantially better for Specialty Chemicals. If you could help us understand, they seem to be slightly dichotomous.

analyst_concerns.question: What is the impact seen for this quarter from tariffs by way of volumes or geographic changes?
analyst_concerns.quote: could you give us a sense of what is the impact that you've seen for this quarter, whether by way of volumes or whether you've had to change some geographic locations?

analyst_concerns.question: How do competitor capacities like Tanfac's new R32 plant shape up under the quota regime?
analyst_concerns.quote: Sir just wanted to understand, a player like Tanfac Industries which has decided to put 20,000 metric tonnes of R32, which, as I understand, should come on stream in Q3 of the next financial year. So how do you see that shaping up for them?
